LanguageData.FB_ColonyBrain_Structure_VoiceOrgan_Desc: Speaks with a living carrier's voice so traders and factions believe they are hailing a human colony.
LanguageData.FB_ColonyBrain_Structure_FleshTradeBeaco: Marks the goods around it as ready for sale to orbital ships.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganSelectCarrierDesc: Choose a living person to seat inside the organ's throat. Only someone able to talk can lend it a voice. The carrier is suspended while held and can be taken back out at any time.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganEjectCarrierDesc: Take the carrier out of the organ. The colony falls silent until another one is seated.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganCannotWalkIn: cannot walk there and must be carried
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganCarrierCannotTalk: {0} cannot talk and can lend no voice.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganOpenCommsDesc: Hail a passing ship or a distant faction through the carrier's voice. Their social skill decides how well the talking goes.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganNoCommTargets: Nobody is within reach of the signal.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganGrowBeaconDesc: Grow a flesh trade beacon. Goods stacked around it can be sold to orbital ships.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganBeaconLocked: The trade beacon has not been unlocked yet.
LanguageData.FB_VoiceOrganSilentInspect: Silent. Seat a carrier to give it a voice.
